changes.text: 作者认为，左宗棠的反驳重心在账上，不过原话里也有「挫國威」这样的非财务理由。他认为割弃不等于省钱：关陇新平，不趁势收回旧地，反而让帕夏另立一国，是坐自遗患；帕夏若守不住，地不是归英就是入俄，地盘坐缩，边防要地尽失，防边的兵也减不掉。传记记其言：「關隴新平，不及時規還國家舊所沒地，而割棄使別為國，此坐自遺患。萬一帕夏不能有，不西為英並，即北折而入俄耳。吾地坐縮，邊要盡失，防邊兵不可減，糜餉自若。無益海防而挫國威，且長亂。此必不可。」作者以为，要害在中段：兵减不掉，饷照旧要花。

One reading is that Zuo's answer rested chiefly on cost, though his words also cite damage to the state's prestige. Carving territory loose, he argued, did not save money: it stored up trouble, and if Pasha failed to hold the land it would fall to England or to Russia; the territory would shrink, every strategic point be lost, and the frontier troops could not be cut. The biography gives his words: "Guanlong has only just been pacified. Instead of recovering in good time the lands the state once lost, we carve them off and let another state be founded there — that is to store up trouble of our own making. Should Pasha fail to hold them, they will be swallowed by England in the west or fold north into Russia. Our territory shrinks of its own accord, every strategic point is lost, the frontier troops cannot be reduced, and the spending goes on as before. It does nothing for coastal defense, it damages our prestige, and it feeds disorder. This must not be." In the author's reading, the sting is in the middle: the troops cannot be cut, and the money flows out all the same.

In the third month of the third year Jintang took Dabancheng and released every Turkic Muslim he had captured, sending them home. Panic spread through the south; the next day Toksun fell, other columns stormed the cities and passes and recovered Turpan, and more than ten thousand Muslims submitted. Then Pasha's end: he drank poison and died; his son Bokhuli killed his own brother and fled to Kashgar. The freeing of the captives and the panic in the south are set down side by side.
三年三月，锦棠攻克达坂城，悉释所擒缠回，纵之归。南路恟惧；次日收托克逊城，另部连破诸城隘，收吐鲁番，降缠回万余。接着是帕夏的结局：饮药死，其子伯克胡里戕其弟，走喀什噶尔。放回俘虏与南路恟惧，传记写在一处。

Chong Hou was disgraced and removed, and Zeng Jize sent to Russia to revise the treaty. Zuo asked to move out to Hami to prepare the recovery of Ili. In the fourth month of the sixth year he set out from Suzhou "carrying his coffin" and reached Hami in the fifth. Russia, hearing the imperial army was moving in force, reinforced Ili and the Naryn and put warships to sea to shake the capital; Tianjin, Fengtian and Shandong were all on alert. In the seventh month Zuo was summoned to the capital as an adviser, and Jintang, a commander of the expedition, replaced him; the biography says Russia too was cowed by the might of the Qing army. In the first month of the following year peace was concluded, Ili returned, and the coastal forces stood down.
崇厚得罪去，命曾纪泽使俄更前约，左宗棠自请出屯哈密，规复伊犁。六年四月，他「輿櫬發肅州」——抬着棺材从肃州出发，五月抵哈密。俄闻王师大出，增兵守伊犁、纳林河，别以兵船翔海上，用震撼京师，天津、奉天、山东皆警。七月诏左宗棠入都备顾问，由西征将领锦棠接替他；传记称「俄亦懾我兵威」，明年正月和议成，交还伊犁，防海军皆罢。

dispositions.rationale: 段末对原话要害的评判改为明确标注的作者解释：中文改为“作者以为，要害在中段”，英文同步改为“In the author's reading, the sting is in the middle”。引语与其余文字不变。

evidence.quote: 防邊兵不可減，糜餉自若

dispositions.rationale: 英文删去证据不支持的“of the south”，改为“released every Turkic Muslim he had captured, sending them home”，与原文及中文版一致。中文原文无此限定，按同步要求照录未改。
删去英文中无中文对应的作者评语“written from the Qing side,”，恢复中英一致。中文原样保留，引语「俄亦懾我兵威」逐字见于证据。

evidence.quote: 而俄亦懾我兵威，恐事遂決裂
